## Profile Overview
Muhammad Umair is a self-employed specialist with over 5 years of hands-on experience in off-page SEO, specializing in white-hat guest posting, outreach, and backlink audit campaigns. Over the past year, he has expanded his core expertise to technical audits, on-page SEO optimization, and local SEO (Google Business Profile setup and ranking).

On the development side, he designs and ships websites and mobile applications using WordPress, Next.js, React, and Flutter. He specializes in combining core coding skills with AI-assisted "vibe coding" workflows (using tools like Cursor and Antigravity) to deploy production-ready applications rapidly.

## Services Offered

### 1. Off-Page SEO
- White-hat link building, organic blogger outreach, and comprehensive backlink audits.
- Strict anti-spam standards: absolutely no PBNs, link farms, or paid link schemes.
- Guest posting campaigns, competitor backlink gap analysis, directory submissions, and local citations.

### 2. On-Page & Technical SEO
- Complete website audits to identify crawl errors, canonical tag bugs, and duplicate content/metadata.
- Heading hierarchy corrections, internal link mapping, page title & meta descriptions optimization.
- Technical speed optimizations for Core Web Vitals (mobile and desktop).

### 3. Local SEO & Google Business Profile
- Setting up, optimizing, and auditing Google Business Profiles (GMB/GBP).
- Ensuring NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency across the web.
- Writing geo-targeted local content and map pack optimization.

### 4. WordPress Development
- Building custom WordPress websites, custom themes, and custom plugins.
- Handling site migrations, database optimization, and performance audits.

### 5. Next.js & React Web Apps
- Developing full-stack web applications utilizing Next.js (App Router), Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS.
- SaaS MVP development, payments integration (Stripe), and API integrations.

### 6. Flutter Mobile App Development
- Constructing native cross-platform mobile apps for Android and iOS using Flutter.
- Fast prototyping and app store submission support.

## Key Case Studies & Projects

### Rotten Deck Repair
- Rank-and-rent site built with WordPress (Kadence Theme) and Rank Math.
- Shipped 47 pages across 12 releases with custom service schema, LocalBusiness schema, and FAQ schemas.

### Fence Rockwall Texas
- Local service site using Kadence. Shipped city-targeted landing pages optimized for search density, regional statutes, and mobile responsiveness.

### FlagCreators
- AI-powered flag design SaaS built on Next.js 14, Supabase, Stripe, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Fully responsive custom drawing canvas, subscription webhooks, and print-on-demand APIs.

### ReceiptsFaker
- Online receipt generator tool. Optimized 18 store-specific landing pages. Took organic traffic from zero to 56,500+ clicks and 134,000+ impressions in 28 days on Search Console. Mobile page speed improved 54 to 78.
